Highest measured impact

Measured numbers, each with its source

  1. Vault Index500xless text for the agent to read
    How it was measured

    5 passages, about 3,500 characters in all against the 24 to 224 whole files a keyword search returns.

    Source: assets/measurements.md
  2. Capy84%cheaper to draft from a written note
    How it was measured

    A measured draft went from $0.061 to $0.010 when drafts moved to a smaller model.

    Source: CHANGELOG, version 1.13.11
  3. Team Knowledge Q&A30% to 90%of test questions found the right page in the top 5
    How it was measured

    20 test questions, vector search against 30% for the keyword search the app uses today. The questions were written from chosen pages, so real questions will score lower.

    Source: README.md, section Search quality
  4. Team Memory Agent54 s to under 2 sto sync when nothing has changed
    How it was measured

    Each layer is rebuilt only when its inputs changed. Recorded on 2026-10-07.

    Source: README.md, section The lake
Each number names its source on its product page.
